body: Blueface proposes to Chrisean Rock in the club and she says yes. Blue and Chrisean’s relationship continues to take wild turns. Early Monday morning (Oct. 12), the rapper proposed to Chrisean at Problem Lounge in Scottsdale, Ariz. Video of the proposal shows the couple in a crowded club, when bottle service women surprise Chrisean with a big sign that reads, “Will You Mary Me? ” Chrisean is totally surprised and appears to eventually say yes.

source_caption_text:
Blueface proposes to Chrisean Rock in the club and she says yes.

Blue and Chrisean’s relationship continues to take wild turns. Early Monday morning (Oct. 12), the rapper proposed to Chrisean at Problem Lounge in Scottsdale, Ariz. Video of the proposal shows the couple in a crowded club, when bottle service women surprise Chrisean with a big sign that reads, “Will You Mary Me?” Chrisean is totally surprised and appears to eventually say yes.

The proposal comes weeks after Blue broke up with his latest girlfriend, Nevaeh, who birthed the rapper’s namesake back in August. Blue appeared to throw shade at Nevaeh on livestream after asking for Chrisean’s hand in marriage.

“Ha. You mad!” he repeated, while getting sloppy kisses from Chrisean.

🎥: Kick/Blueface
